notes.title: Linux and Mac is now supported.
notes.content:
Howdy all, 

We've successfully built/tested Linux and Mac versions of Bloody Mary.

So now even more people can explore the dark realms of Bloody Mary: Forgotten Curse.

In the next update we'll be adding:

- Gamepad support
- AI bug fixes
- More dynamic environment to keep the pace of the game consistent.

notes.title: Testing is over and we're ready for release
notes.content:
If there is anyone out there D:

There was quite a bit of feedback and I'm proud to say that all reported issues have been fixed. There's no doubt that there will be more issues (no game is bug free).

I'd just like to say thank you to all the testers. Last but not least, everyone that's been part of this journey while developing this game. Friends, family, puppies and cats... You all rock. <3

notes.title: We've gone into Beta testing, come join us on discord.
notes.content:
The first round of public testing has started. If you'd like to join beta testing, come and introduce yourself on our discord server: [url=https://discord.gg/gztGTG]https://discord.gg/gztGTG[/url]

The beta keys are limited, so be quick to join us on discord.
